title: Very Poor - Mashreq Gold Customer
body:
Having received the e-mail broadcast I looked forward to installing this app.
The GUI design is shamefully poor - very badly designed look and feel. Just go to any of the more popular app's and please get yourselves a decent graphic designer on board.
I Tried to use it for a utility payment and it doesn't even list my beneficiaries.
This app is poorly conceived, badly developed and clearly hasn't been tested by anyone.
This is hardly a good start for a retail bank that is trying to become customer centric and promote the use of mobile technology.
